districts.name: BRICKSIDE

districts.name: CANE HILL
districts.clear_msg: Cane Hill is ours. The view's even better crime-free.

districts.name: LANTERN LANE
districts.clear_msg: Lantern Lane is lit and quiet. Ghosts, take the night off.

districts.name: STARFORT POINT
districts.clear_msg: Starfort Point holds! The flag flies over a safe shore.

districts.clear_msg: Marble Steps are clear. Time to scrub 'em and sit.

districts.name: BALLYARD FLATS
districts.clear_msg: Ballyard Flats is clean. Play ball, the street is safe!

drone_captions: The harbor basin glitters like a dish of spilled sequins.
Water taxis stitch blue lines from pier to pier.
Rowhouses line up shoulder to shoulder like a marching band.
Marble steps shine on every stoop. Somebody scrubbed this morning.
Painted window screens wink back from the rowhouse fronts.
The star fort sits at the harbor mouth, flag snapping in the wind.
From up here the old fort really does look like a star.
The market hall roof steams with the smell of lunch.
Cobblestone streets curl down to the old wharves.
A high bridge arcs across the outer harbor like a silver thread.
Drawbridges and rail bridges cross the river's branches.
The big sugar sign glows red over the wharf after dark.
Ballpark lights hum over the old brick warehouse.
A tall monument column stands guard over its leafy square.
The hill park gives the best view in town. Ask any pigeon.
Every block below is clear. Harold's work is done. For now.
credits: Thanks to the toads, the true heroes
Thanks to the pigeon, who never paid rent
Thanks to the wheel, for eating our mistakes
Rooftop scouting by the Penthouse Pigeon
Wheelie coaching by the Wheelie Kings
Ghost wrangling: the Fells Point Phantoms
Duckpin rentals courtesy of Kingpin Carl
Towels supplied by the Key Highway Otters
No pigeons were bribed. Just fed.
See you on the stoop, hon.
crowd_lines: The boss is down! Party on the block!
Pots and pans, everybody! Make some noise!
Grab the lawn chairs, we're staying out!
Street's back to normal, thank goodness!
Who needs a superhero? We got Harold!
